階.meaning: floor, story (counter for floors of a building)
階.label: counter

弟.reading: てい, だい, おとうと
弟.label: people

館.meaning: building, hall, mansion (suffix for public buildings)
館.label: place

供.reading: きょう, く, とも, そな(える)
供.label: people

達.meaning: reach, attain; plural marker for people (友達 = friend(s))
達.label: concept

母.reading: ぼ, はは, おかあ(さん)
母.label: people

話.reading: わ, はな(す), はなし
話.label: verb

鉛.meaning: lead (metal); used in 鉛筆 = pencil
鉛.label: object

名.reading: めい, みょう, な
名.label: concept

歩.reading: ほ, ぶ, ある(く), あゆ(む)
歩.label: verb

都.meaning: metropolis, capital city; (in 京都) Kyoto
都.label: place

休.meaning: rest, take a day off; holiday
休.label: verb

私.reading: し, わたし, わたくし
私.label: people

全.reading: ぜん, すべ(て), まった(く)
全.label: concept

然.meaning: state, condition, manner; (in 全然) at all
然.label: concept

勉.meaning: endeavor, exert oneself; (in 勉強) study
勉.label: concept

強.reading: きょう, ごう, つよ(い), し(いる)
強.label: concept

家.reading: か, け, いえ, うち
家.label: place

出.reading: しゅつ, すい, で(る), だ(す)
出.meaning: go out, exit; put out, take out
出.label: verb

戻.reading: れい, もど(る), もど(す)
戻.meaning: return (general — distinct from 帰る which means to return home)
戻.label: verb

先.meaning: ahead, previous, future, tip; (in 先生) teacher
先.label: concept

生.reading: せい, しょう, い(きる), う(まれる), なま
生.meaning: life, birth, raw; (in 先生) teacher, (in 学生) student
生.label: concept

聞.reading: ぶん, もん, き(く)
聞.label: verb

言.reading: げん, ごん, い(う), こと
言.label: verb

音.reading: おん, いん, おと, ね
音.label: object

楽.reading: がく, らく, たの(しい)
楽.label: concept

大.reading: だい, たい, おお(きい)
大.label: concept

阪.meaning: slope (used almost exclusively in the place name 大阪 Osaka)
阪.label: name

緒.meaning: together; cord, strap; (in 一緒に) together
緒.label: concept

男.reading: だん, なん, おとこ
男.label: people

女.reading: じょ, にょ, おんな
女.label: people

田.meaning: rice paddy, field; common in Japanese surnames (山田, 田中)
田.label: name

仕.reading: し, じ, つか(える)
仕.meaning: serve, do; (in 仕事) work, job
仕.label: verb

事.meaning: thing, matter, affair; (in 仕事) job
事.label: concept

父.reading: ふ, ちち, おとう(さん)
父.label: people

紅.reading: こう, く, べに, くれない
紅.meaning: red, crimson; (in 紅茶) black tea
紅.label: object

茶.meaning: tea; (お茶 = green tea, 紅茶 = black tea)
茶.label: object

映.reading: えい, うつ(る), うつ(す), は(える)
映.label: verb

画.meaning: picture, drawing, painting; (in 映画) movie
画.label: object

始.reading: し, はじ(まる), はじ(める)
始.label: verb

終.reading: しゅう, お(わる), お(える)
終.label: verb

物.reading: ぶつ, もつ, もの
物.meaning: thing, object; (in 買い物) shopping, (in 食べ物) food
物.label: object

去.meaning: leave, past; (in 去年) last year
去.label: concept

英.meaning: English; hero, excellent; (in 英語) English language
英.label: concept

村.meaning: village; common in Japanese surnames (木村, 中村)
村.label: name

夕.meaning: evening; (in 夕方) early evening, (in 夕飯) dinner
夕.label: time

方.meaning: direction, way; person (polite suffix); (in 夕方) evening
方.label: concept

間.reading: かん, けん, あいだ, ま
間.meaning: interval, between, time period; (in 時間) time, hour
間.label: concept

四時.meaning: 4 o'clock — exception: NOT しじ or よんじ
四時.label: time

七時.meaning: 7 o'clock — exception: NOT ななじ in time expressions
七時.label: time

九時.meaning: 9 o'clock — exception: NOT きゅうじ. Most-tested time-reading trap
九時.label: time

三階.reading: さんがい (also さんかい)
三階.meaning: 3rd floor — note the voiced reading さんがい is more standard
三階.label: counter

五分.meaning: 5 minutes — uses ふん (not ぷん) after ご
五分.label: time

三分.meaning: 3 minutes — uses ぷん with sokuon-like sound shift
三分.label: time

四.meaning: four — three readings used in different counters (4時=よじ, 4月=しがつ, 4人=よにん)
四.label: number

日月.reading: にちげつ / じつげつ
日月.meaning: Rare classical word: 'sun and moon' or 'days and months / time'. Modern usage: more commonly seen as the kanji pair from 日曜日 + 月曜日 (Sun + Mon)
日月.label: time

火水.meaning: Not a real Japanese word — appears here as a kanji pair from days of the week: 火曜日 (Tue) + 水曜日 (Wed). Useful for memorizing day kanji together
火水.label: time

木金.meaning: Not a real Japanese word — appears here as a kanji pair from days of the week: 木曜日 (Thu) + 金曜日 (Fri). Useful for memorizing day kanji together
木金.label: time

一日.reading: ついたち / いちにち
一日.meaning: TWO readings: ついたち = 1st of the month (date); いちにち = one day (duration). Context decides which
一日.label: date

二十日.meaning: 20th of the month — irregular reading. NOT にじゅうにち
二十日.label: date

八日.meaning: 8th of the month — irregular reading. NOT はちにち
八日.label: date

四日.meaning: 4th of the month — irregular. Note: 14日 = じゅうよっか, 24日 = にじゅうよっか follow same pattern
四日.label: date

十日.meaning: 10th of the month — uses kun-yomi とお of 十
十日.label: date

九日.meaning: 9th of the month — irregular. Compare 9時=くじ — different counters use different number readings
九日.label: date

七人.reading: しちにん / ななにん
七人.meaning: 7 people — both readings acceptable; しちにん is slightly more traditional
七人.label: counter

何人.reading: なんにん / なんじん
何人.meaning: TWO readings with DIFFERENT meanings: なんにん = how many people; なんじん = of what nationality
何人.label: counter

一月.meaning: January (month name). Different from ひとつき (= one-month duration, rare usage)
一月.label: time

四月.meaning: April — month names use on-yomi consistently. NOT よんがつ or よがつ (compare 4時 = よじ)
四月.label: time

今年.meaning: this year — IRREGULAR reading. NOT こんねん
今年.label: time

今朝.meaning: this morning — IRREGULAR reading. NOT こんあさ
今朝.label: time

今晩.meaning: tonight, this evening. Common greeting: 今晩は (こんばんは) = good evening
今晩.label: time

三千五百円.reading: さんぜんごひゃくえん
三千五百円.meaning: 3,500 yen — note voicing: 三千 = さんぜん (not さんせん)
三千五百円.label: number

一万円.meaning: 10,000 yen — must say 一万 (ichi-man), NOT just 万 alone (unlike English 'ten thousand')
一万円.label: number

誰と.meaning: with whom — 誰 (who) + と (together with). Compare: 誰が (who, subject), 誰に (to whom)
誰と.label: phrase
